questionText: Consider a TCP connection between a client and a server with the following specifications: the round trip time is $6\text{ ms}$, the size of the receiver advertised window is $50\text{ KB}$, slow-start threshold at the client is $32\text{ KB}$, and the maximum segment size is $2\text{ KB}$. The connection is established at time $t = 0$. Assume that there are no timeouts and errors during transmission. Then the size of the congestion window (in KB) at time $t + 60\text{ ms}$ after all acknowledgements are processed is ________.
explanation:
Given Data:
Round Trip Time (RTT) = $6\text{ ms}$
Receiver Advertised Window ($rwnd$) = $50\text{ KB}$
Slow-Start Threshold ($ssthresh$) = $32\text{ KB}$
Maximum Segment Size ($MSS$) = $2\text{ KB}$
Initial Congestion Window ($cwnd$) = $1\text{ MSS} = 2\text{ KB}$ at $t = 0$

Step-by-Step Calculation:
Total time elapsed = $60\text{ ms}$, which corresponds to $\frac{60}{6} = 10\text{ RTTs}$.

1. Slow-Start Phase ($cwnd < ssthresh$):
During slow-start, $cwnd$ doubles every RTT.
- Initial $cwnd = 2\text{ KB}$
- After 1st RTT ($t = 6\text{ ms}$): $cwnd = 4\text{ KB}$
- After 2nd RTT ($t = 12\text{ ms}$): $cwnd = 8\text{ KB}$
- After 3rd RTT ($t = 18\text{ ms}$): $cwnd = 16\text{ KB}$
- After 4th RTT ($t = 24\text{ ms}$): $cwnd = 32\text{ KB}$

At $t = 24\text{ ms}$, $cwnd$ reaches $ssthresh = 32\text{ KB}$.

2. Congestion Avoidance Phase ($cwnd \ge ssthresh$):
In this phase, $cwnd$ increases linearly by $1\text{ MSS} = 2\text{ KB}$ for each RTT.
- After 5th RTT ($t = 30\text{ ms}$): $cwnd = 32 + 2 = 34\text{ KB}$
- After 6th RTT ($t = 36\text{ ms}$): $cwnd = 34 + 2 = 36\text{ KB}$
- After 7th RTT ($t = 42\text{ ms}$): $cwnd = 36 + 2 = 38\text{ KB}$
- After 8th RTT ($t = 48\text{ ms}$): $cwnd = 38 + 2 = 40\text{ KB}$
- After 9th RTT ($t = 54\text{ ms}$): $cwnd = 40 + 2 = 42\text{ KB}$
- After 10th RTT ($t = 60\text{ ms}$): $cwnd = 42 + 2 = 44\text{ KB}$

Since $cwnd = 44\text{ KB} \le rwnd = 50\text{ KB}$, the size of the congestion window at time $t + 60\text{ ms}$ is 44.
